author: Tooensure LLC
_comment: identity/name/shortName deliberately carry the sourceName token. Because
.template.config is copied into the output, these get substituted too, so a
generated app installs as its OWN template instead of colliding with this one.
That is what makes the recursion work past depth 1.
name: ProjectName PMCR-O application
description: A PMCR-O surface: DSO-shaped screens, trail following, and a generated object catalog. The generated app keeps its own .template.config, so it is itself a template.

OrchestratorUrl.description: Default PMCR-O orchestrator endpoint used on first run.

Recursive.description: Keep .template.config in the output so the generated app is itself a template.
